title: I Ching / 易經 / Book of Changes
edition_basis: Chinese original with modern Chinese line-commentary (hontsev/OpenMomordica corpus); English (Legge 1882 SBE vol 16) acquisition pending — archive.org 403's from container
classification_note: Named by Lee for transform availability 2026-07-01. Foundational Chinese divinatory-philosophical classic. Zodiacal assignment: Sen Kuro / Virgo per Lee's adjudication 2026-07-01. Chinese original with hexagram judgments (卦辞), Image commentaries (象曰), Duan commentaries (彖曰), and line commentaries (爻辞) — plus modern Chinese line-by-line paraphrase. English Legge translation pending followup pass.

casting_workflow.unit_note: One hexagram (卦辞 + 象辞) is the lyric unit. Ranges remain available for special casts; default cast = 1 unit. Supersedes the three-hexagram span shown in TX-60176854.

classical.note: 卦辞 and 象辞 classical text only — the operator transforms this layer (~100–200 chars)

yiwen.note: modern Chinese commentary renders statically; never enters the LLM pipeline

english.note: English rendering displays statically; translation pass applies to the operator's transform output only, not the source layers

figure.input: unit binary string (bottom line = last bit)
figure.style: six bars, solid=yang broken=yin, inline SVG; trigram pair rendered small beside main figure; no external image assets — the figure is generated, license-free

card_anatomy: 卦名 large + pinyin + King Wen number
structure line (e.g. 水地比 · Water over Earth)

moving_lines.note: classical present→future mechanic as possible future two-unit workflow; feature decision, not part of this fix

casting_workflow.rationale: MANUS directive 2026-07-11: restrict casting length for non-English canonical texts; transform-then-translate over three hexagrams duplicated the full bilingual source twice per reading. Unit reduction (3→1) plus layer separation (transform classical only) cuts LLM cost ~6x and returns the reading to one card, one hexagram, one breath.
